description: An accounting degree from Sacred Heart University is the perfect start to a rewarding career in a dynamic and diverse field. Our program is a leader in accounting education, recognized for its commitment to student success. You will gain a strong foundation in all areas of accounting, including financial accounting, managerial accounting, auditing, taxation, and accounting information systems. As a graduate, you'll be prepared for a variety of roles in public accounting, corporate accounting, government, and non-profit organizations. With a Sacred Heart accounting degree, you'll be well-prepared for the CPA Exam.
Accreditation status: The Jack Welch College of Business & Technology is accredited by AACSB International, the premier accrediting agency for business schools worldwide.

description: A minor in accounting is designed for students seeking a background in financial concepts and the theory and practice of accounting to complement their chosen major field of study. Students will gain an understanding of financial reporting, managerial accounting, and other specialized areas of accounting that can enhance their career prospects across various industries. This minor is suitable for students pursuing careers in finance, business management, entrepreneurship, law, or any field where a solid grasp of financial data and its interpretation is valuable.

Sacred Heart University’s Acting BA program provides students with a solid foundation in the techniques of acting, voice, and movement. Through an intensive conservatory-style program, students learn how to connect with other actors, tell a story through movement, and deliver lines effectively. The program fosters creative, intellectual, and professional development and prepares students for a career in the arts or for further graduate study. Students perform in mainstage productions, work on screen projects, create original works, and have opportunities to audition for professional productions and gain real-world experience. Sacred Heart University is a member of the National Association of Schools of Theatre (NAST).
Accreditation status: Member of the National Association of Schools of Theatre (NAST)

description: The acting minor prepares students in the liberal arts to develop skills in the craft of acting through foundational work in movement, voice, improvisation, and scene study. The minor is a practical program intended to prepare students to pursue further training in a conservatory or graduate program, or to enter the profession directly. The Acting minor serves as a gateway to the Theatre Arts major at Sacred Heart University.

The American Studies minor provides an interdisciplinary approach to the study of the United States, its culture, and its place in the world. It provides a unique lens through which to explore American history, literature, politics, religion, sociology, and other aspects of American life. The minor helps students develop critical thinking and communication skills and prepares them for a wide range of career paths. The American Studies minor is an excellent complement to many majors, including history, political science, English, communication, and sociology. It allows students to delve deeply into the complexities of American society and culture, fostering a deeper understanding of the nation's past, present, and future. Students gain a holistic perspective on America by drawing on diverse academic fields, which enhances their analytical abilities and broadens their intellectual horizons.

The Applied Physics minor provides students with a foundational understanding of the principles of physics and their application across various scientific and engineering disciplines. This minor is designed for students interested in augmenting their primary major with a strong background in analytical thinking and problem-solving derived from physical principles. The curriculum emphasizes practical applications, preparing students for careers in research, technology, and industry, or for further graduate studies. Students will explore topics such as mechanics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics, and modern physics, gaining hands-on experience through laboratory work and computational tools.

At Sacred Heart University, our Art & Design program provides a diverse and dynamic education that blends traditional techniques with modern technologies. Students develop their artistic voice and technical skills across various mediums, preparing them for creative careers in a rapidly evolving visual landscape. The curriculum emphasizes critical thinking, problem-solving, and hands-on experience, fostering a deep understanding of art history and contemporary design practices. Our faculty, composed of practicing artists and designers, are dedicated to mentoring students and guiding them through a rigorous and rewarding academic journey. Graduates emerge with a comprehensive portfolio, strong foundational knowledge, and the professional acumen necessary to succeed in a wide array of art and design fields.

The Sacred Heart University minor in Art & Design allows students to express themselves visually and develop creative, critical thinking, problem-solving, communication, and technological skills that are applicable to a wide range of career paths. This minor complements any major through an exploration of the elements and principles of design, historical and contemporary art and design movements, and hands-on experience in studio art and digital design. The Art & Design minor prepares students to contribute to the visual culture of their organizations through the development of a creative portfolio and professional writing skills needed to pursue graduate study and/or careers in art, graphic design, and other visual media.

The Art History Minor introduces students to the visual arts of various cultures and periods. Through the lens of art history, students gain a deeper understanding of human society and experience, developing critical thinking, visual analysis, and research skills. A minor in art history complements a variety of majors including studio art, graphic design, history, literature, philosophy, and communications, among others.

Sacred Heart University’s Bachelor of Science in Artificial Intelligence is an innovative program that provides students with the foundational and practical knowledge to understand, design, and implement AI systems. This program emphasizes problem-solving and critical thinking, preparing graduates to excel in a rapidly evolving technological landscape. The curriculum includes machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and ethics in AI, ensuring a well-rounded education. Graduates will be equipped to pursue careers in various industries, from healthcare and finance to manufacturing and entertainment, and contribute to the advancement of artificial intelligence.

Our Bachelor of Science in Biochemistry degree provides students with a foundational understanding of the principles of biochemistry, equipping them with the knowledge and skills necessary to pursue advanced studies or careers in various fields, including medicine, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, and research. This rigorous program blends biology and chemistry, offering a comprehensive curriculum that explores the molecular basis of life processes. Students in the Biochemistry program will gain a deep understanding of biochemical pathways, molecular genetics, protein structure and function, and experimental techniques. They will develop critical thinking, problem-solving, and laboratory skills essential for success in scientific research and healthcare-related professions.

Our comprehensive Bachelor of Science (BS) in Biology program provides you with an intensive, hands-on, research-based experience and the flexibility to explore your interests through concentration options. Through scientific theory, observation, and experimentation, you’ll investigate the natural world at the cellular, organismal, and ecosystem levels. With an emphasis on undergraduate research, our program provides a modern curriculum that prepares you to thrive as a professional scientist or pursue further study in graduate school or health-related professional programs. Our state-of-the-art facilities include analytical and microscopy labs, tissue culture and molecular biology facilities, a greenhouse, and a vivarium, all of which enhance your classroom learning.

A minor in biology is a great complement to many majors. It allows students to develop a strong scientific background in the life sciences without committing to a full major. The biology minor requires six courses (20-24 credits) selected from an approved list of biology courses. The minor allows flexibility so students can tailor the minor to their interests and future career goals. Students will take courses in the core areas of biology, including cell, molecular, organismal, and evolutionary biology, as well as ecology. Additionally, students will develop strong laboratory skills, learn to critically analyze scientific literature, and develop presentation and communication skills.

The Black Studies minor provides students with an interdisciplinary understanding of the global Black experience. The minor is composed of 18 credits across a wide range of disciplines including history, literature, political science, sociology, art history, and more. Through a combination of required and elective courses, students will explore topics such as the history of slavery and colonialism, civil rights movements, contemporary social justice issues, and the rich cultural traditions of Black communities worldwide. Students will develop critical thinking skills, a nuanced understanding of racial dynamics, and an appreciation for the contributions of Black individuals and communities to society. This minor complements a variety of majors and can lead to careers in fields such as education, social work, public policy, journalism, and non-profit organizations. It also serves as excellent preparation for graduate studies in disciplines such as ethnic studies, history, and sociology.

The Bachelor of Science in Business Economics program teaches students to apply economic principles and quantitative methods to solve business problems and make informed decisions. It combines a rigorous understanding of economic theory with practical business applications. This interdisciplinary approach equips graduates with analytical skills essential for careers in finance, consulting, market research, data analysis, and public policy. The program emphasizes critical thinking, problem-solving, and effective communication, preparing students for success in a dynamic global economy. Our graduates go on to work in a variety of fields and for prestigious companies.

A broad-based business education. The Bachelor of Science in Business Management is designed to provide you with a comprehensive business education. You will develop an understanding of the business environment and the functional areas of business, including accounting, finance, marketing, management, and information systems. The program emphasizes critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, preparing you for a wide range of careers in business or for graduate studies. The curriculum is designed to be flexible, allowing you to tailor your studies to your interests through elective courses and minors. You'll gain practical experience through internships, case studies, and real-world projects, ensuring you are career-ready upon graduation.
Accreditation status: The Welch College of Business & Technology is accredited by AACSB International – The Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business. AACSB accreditation is the hallmark of excellence in business education, earned by less than five percent of the world's business programs.

description: The Catholic Studies Minor aims to introduce students to the richness of the Catholic tradition. The program takes an interdisciplinary approach, drawing from theology, history, philosophy, literature, and art. Students will engage with the intellectual, spiritual, and cultural aspects of Catholicism, exploring its historical development, theological foundations, ethical teachings, and its impact on Western civilization and contemporary society. Through critical inquiry and dialogue, students will develop a nuanced understanding of Catholicism, its contributions to humanity, and its continued relevance in the modern world.

At Sacred Heart University, our Chemistry B.S. program is a robust, hands-on, research-based curriculum designed to prepare you for a range of professional careers or graduate studies. As a chemistry major, you’ll be immersed in all aspects of the chemical sciences, from foundational principles to advanced analytical techniques. Our approach emphasizes practical experience, critical thinking, and a deep understanding of chemical theories, ensuring you’re well-equipped for the scientific challenges of tomorrow. You’ll engage in laboratory work, research projects, and independent studies, all while benefitting from personalized mentorship from our dedicated faculty.
The chemistry curriculum is designed to provide you with a comprehensive understanding of the major sub-disciplines within chemistry: analytical, biochemistry, inorganic, organic, and physical chemistry. You'll gain extensive hands-on experience with modern instrumentation and experimental techniques, preparing you for immediate entry into the workforce or advanced graduate studies. Beyond the classroom, opportunities for research with faculty mentors abound, allowing you to contribute to cutting-edge scientific discoveries and present your work at national conferences. Our graduates are highly sought after in diverse fields, including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, environmental science, and materials science, as well as medical and professional schools.

The chemistry minor is designed to supplement other majors, allowing students to gain foundational knowledge in chemistry, which is essential for understanding various scientific and technological fields. The minor provides a strong scientific background for students considering careers in healthcare, biotechnology, education, law, or engineering.

Concentration name: Film & Television, Journalism & Media Production, Public Relations & Advertising, Sports Communication & Media
description: Communication is all around us, in the language we speak, the art we create and the media we consume. It’s what connects us to each other and the world. As a communication studies major at Sacred Heart University, you'll delve into the vital role of communication in building effective relationships, solving problems, fostering understanding, and influencing change across diverse contexts. You will explore a broad range of communication areas including media studies, public relations, advertising, journalism, digital communication, and film and television production. Through a blend of theoretical knowledge and practical application, you'll develop expertise in critical analysis, strategic thinking, ethical decision-making, and effective communication across various platforms. Our curriculum emphasizes hands-on learning, collaborative projects, and real-world experiences, preparing you to thrive in a dynamic global society.

In the Computer Engineering program, you will focus on the design and development of digital hardware and software systems. You will gain a deep understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, networks, and software engineering principles. The curriculum covers a wide range of topics, including digital signal processing, embedded systems, microprocessors, VLSI design, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. You'll work on practical projects and gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies. Our state-of-the-art facilities and experienced faculty will provide you with the tools and knowledge to succeed in the rapidly evolving field of computer engineering.

The Computer Science BS program at Sacred Heart University offers a comprehensive curriculum that emphasizes both theoretical foundations and practical application. Students gain a deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, programming languages, operating systems, and computer networks, while also exploring emerging fields like artificial intelligence, machine learning, cybersecurity, and data science. The program fosters critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and innovation, preparing graduates for successful careers in a rapidly evolving technological landscape or for further graduate studies. Through hands-on projects, research opportunities, and internships, students develop the expertise to design, implement, and manage complex software systems and contribute to advancements in computing technology. Immerse yourself in the world of computing with our comprehensive Computer Science BS program. At Sacred Heart University, we go beyond the classroom, offering a dynamic curriculum that combines theoretical foundations with hands-on application. You'll explore a wide range of topics, from algorithms and data structures to artificial intelligence and cybersecurity, gaining the skills needed to thrive in today's technology-driven world. Our dedicated faculty, state-of-the-art facilities, and strong industry connections ensure you receive a top-tier education. With opportunities for research, internships, and capstone projects, you'll graduate ready to innovate and lead in the ever-evolving field of computer science.

The Computer Science minor at Sacred Heart University provides students with a foundational understanding of computer science principles and practices. This minor is an excellent complement to a variety of majors, enabling students to develop critical skills in computational thinking, programming, and problem-solving. It offers a flexible curriculum designed to introduce students to key areas such as software development, data structures, algorithms, and computing theory. Through hands-on projects and relevant coursework, students will gain valuable technical expertise that is highly sought after in today’s technology-driven world, preparing them for diverse career paths or further study in technology-related fields.

The Creative Writing minor at Sacred Heart University allows students to explore their creative potential through writing across various genres. Students develop their craft in fiction, poetry, creative nonfiction, screenwriting, and playwriting. Through workshops and seminars, students refine their voice, learn about literary techniques, and engage in critical discussions about contemporary and classic works. The minor culminates in a capstone project, where students produce a substantial piece of original creative work, demonstrating their mastery of chosen genres and their unique artistic vision.

At Sacred Heart University, our Bachelor of Arts in Criminal Justice program offers a comprehensive study of the American criminal justice system. You will explore the theoretical frameworks, institutional practices, and policy implications related to crime, deviance, and social control. Our curriculum is designed to provide you with a deep understanding of law enforcement, courts, corrections, and community-based programs.

As a Criminal Justice major, you will develop critical thinking, research, and analytical skills essential for careers in various criminal justice fields or for advanced study. Our program emphasizes ethical decision-making, social justice, and a commitment to serving diverse communities. You'll gain hands-on experience through internships and community engagement opportunities, preparing you for real-world challenges.

Sacred Heart University’s Bachelor of Science in Cybersecurity program prepares students to protect computer systems and networks from cyber threats. Students will learn how to design, implement, and maintain secure systems, as well as how to detect and respond to cyberattacks. The curriculum covers a wide range of topics, including network security, cryptography, digital forensics, ethical hacking, and risk management. With a strong emphasis on hands-on learning, students will gain practical experience through labs, simulations, and real-world projects. Graduates will be well-prepared for careers in cybersecurity, including security analyst, security engineer, incident responder, and penetration tester.

Digital marketing uses web and social media channels to interact with consumers, create brands, and sell products and services. Sacred Heart’s Digital Marketing program provides students with the critical skills and knowledge needed for a successful career in a constantly evolving field. The program prepares students for positions in digital marketing strategy, social media marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), digital analytics, and content marketing. Students will learn how to: Identify opportunities to use digital tools to promote products, services, and brands. Formulate comprehensive digital marketing strategies. Create content for digital platforms. Measure the success of digital marketing efforts using analytics. Adapt to new digital technologies and trends.

An economics minor is an excellent choice for students who want to broaden their understanding of resource allocation, decision-making, and market behavior. This minor complements a wide range of majors, including finance, marketing, political science, history, and even nursing. It equips students with valuable analytical skills and a strong foundation in economic principles that are applicable in virtually any field. Studying economics involves examining how individuals, businesses, and governments make choices when facing scarcity. This minor delves into both microeconomics (individual and firm behavior) and macroeconomics (broader economic trends like inflation, unemployment, and economic growth). Through a combination of theoretical knowledge and practical applications, students will learn to analyze economic issues, evaluate policies, and understand the forces that shape global economies.

The Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering provides students with an education in the fundamental principles of electrical engineering in a broad range of areas. Graduates will be prepared for a variety of entry-level positions in industry or for advanced study. The Electrical Engineering program provides students with the opportunity to pursue an education that meets the requirements for a bachelor of science degree and satisfies requirements for professional engineering licensure. Students will learn the necessary skills in electrical engineering to analyze, design, and implement complex electrical systems. The curriculum emphasizes both theory and practical applications and hands-on laboratory experiences. A strong general education component helps students to develop written and oral communication skills along with problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
Accreditation status: The Electrical Engineering program is accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET, https://www.abet.org.

description:
Engineers are problem solvers who use innovation, technology, and science to improve the world. Sacred Heart University’s engineering program provides students with a broad and foundational understanding of engineering principles while allowing them to develop specialized expertise through various electives. We offer engineering courses for both majors and non-majors, helping students develop an analytical mindset and critical thinking skills.
The Engineering Minor is available to all students seeking to develop a deeper understanding of engineering principles, enhance their critical thinking skills, and broaden their career opportunities. It complements a variety of majors, from science and mathematics to business and the liberal arts, providing a versatile skill set that is highly valued in today’s interdisciplinary professional landscape.
Our program provides a comprehensive engineering education through a unique blend of theoretical knowledge and practical experience. Through hands-on projects, state-of-the-art laboratories, and experiential learning opportunities, students gain real-world skills and prepare for successful careers in a wide range of engineering fields. Our dedicated faculty, with extensive industry experience, provide personalized mentorship and guidance, ensuring students receive a high-quality education and develop the problem-solving and critical thinking skills essential for success.

Sacred Heart University’s Bachelor of Arts in English offers an engaging and inspiring curriculum that prepares you to thrive in a wide range of professions. Our program focuses on developing students' critical reading and thinking skills, sharpening their ability to analyze and interpret complex texts, and empowering them to articulate their ideas with clarity and precision through effective writing. The English major also fosters creativity, cultural awareness, and a deep appreciation for the power of storytelling. Graduates are equipped with highly transferable skills sought after by employers in various fields, including education, publishing, journalism, marketing, law, and non-profit work.

The English minor is a natural for anyone who loves literature and writing, and it also complements any major by strengthening skills in analysis, communication, and critical thinking. It offers a wonderful opportunity to develop a deep appreciation for language, culture, and human experience, and it provides a strong foundation for a variety of career paths.

Climate change, pollution, renewable energy, species extinction, and global warming: these are complex challenges requiring interdisciplinary approaches. Sacred Heart University's Environmental Studies Minor prepares students to address critical environmental issues through coursework in a variety of disciplines and a required internship or research project. Students who pursue the minor often go on to careers in environmental law, urban planning, environmental education, public health, advocacy, sustainable business, conservation, journalism, and more. A minor in Environmental Studies helps students develop critical thinking and problem-solving skills, and a commitment to civic engagement and social justice. These qualities are sought by employers in a range of fields, as well as by graduate programs.

Sacred Heart University’s minor in Esports Management will give you the skills you need to become an industry leader. Learn about the business of esports—including its events, teams, leagues, and digital content. The minor provides a strong foundation in a rapidly growing, billion-dollar industry. The minor is offered to all undergraduate students.

Concentration name: Pre-Athletic Training, Pre-Physical Therapy, Strength and Conditioning
description:
Sacred Heart University's Exercise Science program is nationally recognized as one of the best in the Northeast. Our undergraduate curriculum prepares students for careers in fields such as clinical exercise physiology, strength and conditioning, sports performance, and corporate wellness. Graduates of our program are also well-prepared for graduate study in exercise science, athletic training, physical therapy, physician assistant studies, and occupational therapy.
As an exercise science major, you will study human movement and how the body responds to exercise. You’ll also learn how to use exercise to prevent and treat chronic diseases and injuries, and to improve human health and performance. Our Exercise Science program is designed for students who are passionate about exercise, health, and wellness.
In addition to our general Exercise Science program, you can choose to specialize in one of three areas: Pre-Athletic Training, Pre-Physical Therapy, or Strength and Conditioning. All of our students gain valuable hands-on experience in the classroom, in the lab, and in internships with a wide variety of clinical and sports organizations. You will complete a required minimum of 400 hours of internship experiences as part of the curriculum.

Do you envision a career in the dynamic world of fashion? Sacred Heart University's Bachelor of Science in Fashion Marketing and Merchandising prepares you to work in this exciting global industry. Rooted in a strong business core curriculum, this cross-disciplinary program focuses on both the creative and quantitative aspects of fashion. You will learn about consumer behavior, product development, global sourcing, retail operations, marketing strategies and trend forecasting. Our program provides students with real-world experiences through partnerships with companies like Bloomingdale’s, Macy’s, J.C. Penney, Saks Fifth Avenue, Rent the Runway, Tommy Hilfiger, Marc Jacobs, Ralph Lauren, Vineyard Vines, Vineyard Brands, Chanel, Elie Tahari, and Diane von Furstenberg. With a variety of career paths to choose from, our graduates have gone on to become retail buyers, merchandise planners, visual merchandisers, product developers, fashion event coordinators, fashion forecasters, public relations specialists, stylists and more. Many of our graduates pursue careers in areas such as digital marketing, social media and entrepreneurship. You’ll be prepared for success in the ever-evolving business of fashion.

Finance is the science of money management. Our bachelor of science in finance provides you with a foundation in the analytical tools and quantitative methods necessary to become a successful financial professional. If you want to pursue a career in corporate finance, investment management, or financial planning, our finance program is for you. Learn about:
* Financial statements
* Financial forecasting
* Investment analysis
* Portfolio management
* Risk management
* Options and futures markets
* International financial management
* Financial modeling
You will gain a strong understanding of how financial markets function. Our rigorous curriculum combined with faculty who bring real-world experience to the classroom will help you achieve your career goals. Through an integrated capstone course and the opportunity to pursue research projects, you will learn to apply financial theory to practical applications. We also offer a student-managed investment fund where students actively manage a portion of the University’s endowment portfolio.
As a graduate of our finance program, you will be prepared for a wide range of jobs in various financial fields, including:
* Investment banking
* Commercial banking
* Corporate finance
* Personal financial planning
* Portfolio management
* Risk management
* Real estate
* Insurance
You will also be well-positioned to pursue advanced graduate studies or professional certifications such as the Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA).

Sacred Heart University’s Bachelor of Science (BS) in Financial Technology (FinTech) is a cutting-edge program designed to equip students with the skills and knowledge needed to thrive in the rapidly evolving financial services industry. FinTech integrates finance with technology, focusing on innovative solutions to traditional financial challenges. Our program provides a comprehensive understanding of financial markets, products, and services, combined with proficiency in the technological tools and techniques that are reshaping the industry.

Students will delve into topics such as artificial intelligence, blockchain, data analytics, cybersecurity, and algorithmic trading, learning how these technologies are applied in banking, investment management, insurance, and other financial sectors. The curriculum emphasizes hands-on experience, practical application, and ethical considerations, preparing graduates for careers in FinTech startups, established financial institutions, regulatory bodies, and technology companies.

Our BS in FinTech program is interdisciplinary, drawing expertise from the Welch College of Business & Technology. Students will gain a strong foundation in both financial principles and technological advancements, fostering a holistic understanding of the FinTech ecosystem. Graduates will be prepared to innovate, lead, and adapt in a dynamic global financial landscape, contributing to the development and implementation of future financial solutions.
Accreditation status: The Welch College of Business & Technology is accredited by AACSB International – The Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business.

description: French minor students are exposed to the languages and cultures of the Francophone world while developing a wide range of critical thinking and communication skills necessary to become global citizens. While the study of French opens the door to numerous career paths, it also complements other majors like business, education, communication, political science, international affairs, hospitality, and allied health. In addition to a comprehensive curriculum, students have many opportunities to explore French and Francophone culture through study abroad programs, the French club, and campus events. The French minor also gives students a competitive edge for prestigious Fulbright Scholarships and other international programs.

The game design and development bachelor's degree program at Sacred Heart University challenges students to develop the next generation of games, apps and interactive technologies for education, entertainment and other applications. Students learn how to create engaging experiences that solve real-world problems. They explore the entire game design and development lifecycle, from conceptualization and prototyping to coding and launch. The bachelor's degree in game design and development provides a practical, project-based curriculum that prepares graduates for careers in game design, game development, mobile app development, interactive media and more. Students build a strong portfolio of projects throughout the program, culminating in a senior capstone project where they develop and launch their own game or interactive application.

The Geriatric Health Care minor offers undergraduate students of all majors the opportunity to obtain the education needed to effectively serve the older adult population. This minor is open to all students regardless of major but is especially useful for students in the areas of nursing, physical therapy, occupational therapy, social work, exercise science, physician assistant studies and other health-related fields. Through hands-on experience and fieldwork, students will gain valuable skills to address the complex needs of older adults.

The Global Health minor focuses on key global health issues, challenges, and solutions. This interdisciplinary minor allows students from all academic areas to gain knowledge about the health issues that transcend national boundaries and are influenced by circumstances or experiences in other countries. The minor focuses on prevention, treatment, and care for those with existing conditions, as well as the study of inequities in health and healthcare. The goal is to provide students with a greater understanding of what impacts global health, as well as the policies and initiatives that affect the health of populations worldwide. The minor is a useful addition for students interested in careers in public health, humanitarian aid, medicine, social work, nursing, government, and policy. It also serves as preparation for graduate school programs related to public health and global studies.

The Global Studies program provides students with the intellectual tools to understand the complexity of our increasingly interconnected world. You will explore current events, social and cultural issues, economic trends, political systems, and historical contexts that transcend national borders. The program emphasizes an interdisciplinary approach, drawing from various fields such as history, political science, sociology, economics, and anthropology. Students develop critical thinking, research, and communication skills essential for navigating global challenges and opportunities. Graduates are prepared for careers in international organizations, government agencies, non-profits, multinational corporations, and graduate studies in fields such as international relations, public policy, and global affairs.

The minor in global studies provides students with a multidisciplinary approach to understanding the world. Students in the minor will have the opportunity to engage with various disciplines, including history, political science, sociology, economics, business, languages, and cultures, to develop a comprehensive understanding of global issues. Students pursuing the minor will gain a global perspective while learning about other cultures and critically analyzing the increasingly interconnected world. The global studies minor is an interdisciplinary program that draws on courses from various departments. This minor provides a foundational understanding of global issues while offering flexibility for students to tailor their studies based on their interests. The minor will provide students with a deeper understanding of global issues, cross-cultural competencies, and the ability to engage effectively in a globalized world.

Graphic design is a diverse and multifaceted discipline, and at Sacred Heart University, we’ll help you develop the skills and understanding needed to thrive in this exciting field. Our Bachelor of Arts (BA) in Graphic Design offers a comprehensive curriculum that emphasizes conceptual problem-solving, aesthetic sensibility, technical proficiency and professional practices. Through a combination of traditional and digital media, you’ll learn to communicate effectively across various platforms, including print, web and interactive media. Our faculty are experienced professionals who are dedicated to providing a dynamic and supportive learning environment. You'll gain hands-on experience through studio projects, internships and collaborations, preparing you for a successful career in graphic design or further graduate studies.

Sacred Heart University’s Bachelor of Science in Health Science prepares students for a wide range of careers in healthcare, including allied health, healthcare administration, public health, health and wellness, and health education. With an emphasis on prevention, wellness, and evidence-based practice, students gain a deep understanding of health determinants, health promotion strategies, and healthcare delivery systems. The curriculum emphasizes critical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills, preparing graduates to address the complex challenges facing healthcare today. The Health Science major provides a strong foundation for various careers in the healthcare industry and for graduate studies in allied health fields, such as physical therapy, occupational therapy, athletic training, physician assistant, and public health. You will learn how to promote wellness, prevent disease, and improve health outcomes in diverse populations. Our curriculum focuses on health promotion, disease prevention, health education, and leadership, equipping you with the skills to make a meaningful impact in the lives of others.

Historians seek to understand the human experience through the careful study and critical analysis of the past. The study of history helps students develop an understanding of themselves and their world, as well as an appreciation for the diversity of human experience. The skills students develop in history courses – critical thinking, research, and writing – are highly valued in both academic and professional fields.
Our faculty are dedicated to providing students with an excellent education that prepares them for a wide range of careers and graduate studies. The department offers a wide range of courses, covering diverse historical periods and geographical regions, including American, European, Latin American, African, and Asian history. In addition to traditional lecture courses, students have opportunities to engage in experiential learning through internships, research projects, and study abroad programs.
The History Department provides students with a solid liberal arts foundation and the skills necessary for success in a rapidly changing world. A history major provides excellent preparation for law school, graduate school, education, journalism, public history, government, business, and non-profit organizations.
Students can also pursue a minor in history.

The History Minor at Sacred Heart University offers students from all majors the opportunity to cultivate a deeper understanding of the past. Through a diverse range of courses, students will explore different historical periods and regions, developing critical thinking, research, and analytical skills essential for success in various professional fields and graduate studies.

The Honors Minor provides highly motivated and high-achieving Sacred Heart University students from any major with an opportunity to enhance their academic experience through advanced research, interdisciplinary courses, and special extracurricular programming. Students apply for admission to the Honors Minor in the spring of their freshman year. The curriculum builds on previous learning and intellectual curiosity with the goal of fostering lifelong learners who are engaged citizens in a global society. Students in the Honors Minor benefit from: Opportunities for advanced research and interdisciplinary coursework. Special extracurricular programming. Mentorship from faculty committed to honors education.

The Hospitality, Resort and Tourism Management program provides students with the academic foundation for career opportunities and growth in all areas of the hospitality, resort, and tourism industry. This multi-billion dollar industry is the largest and fastest growing industry in the world, with management opportunities for graduates in hotels, resorts, country clubs, spas, cruise lines, airlines, tour companies, theme parks, attractions, entertainment, gaming, retail, restaurants, catering, private clubs, and meeting and event planning. Graduates of the program will be uniquely prepared for the demands of the 21st century global market. The curriculum provides a strong business core coupled with specialized courses that address the unique management needs of the hospitality and tourism industry. The program requires 120 credit hours for graduation and includes a required internship in an approved setting. The program is offered in the Welch College of Business & Technology. Students pursuing a B.S. in hospitality, resort, and tourism management may not also earn a B.S. in business administration.
Program name: Hospitality, Resort and Tourism Management - BS

description: The Human Resource Management minor is designed to develop students’ knowledge and skills in human resource management functions as well as general management practices. Students will understand the major HR areas including staffing, compensation, training and development, and employee relations. The minor aims to enhance students’ understanding of the strategic role of HR in achieving organizational success and effective human capital management practices. The Human Resource Management minor is an excellent complement to most majors in the Welch College of Business & Technology, as well as several other colleges at Sacred Heart University. This minor is not available to Human Resource Management majors.

Illustrators are creative communicators whose work is critical to telling stories across a variety of media — from books, magazines, and newspapers to comics, advertising, and animation. Sacred Heart University’s Bachelor of Arts in Illustration teaches students a broad range of drawing, painting, and digital techniques while helping them develop their own unique visual voice. You'll learn how to develop concepts, create compelling narratives, and master the tools of the trade to prepare for a successful career as a professional illustrator. In the Illustration BA program, students develop a strong understanding of foundational art principles and build advanced skills in areas such as: Drawing and painting techniques; Digital illustration software and tools; Visual storytelling and narrative development; Character design and concept art; Editorial illustration; Book illustration; Sequential art; Branding and advertising illustration; Professional practices for illustrators.

If you have diverse interests and want to create a unique course of study, Sacred Heart’s interdisciplinary studies program may be the perfect fit. You will design your own major by combining three distinct, yet related, areas of study from across the University. Guided by a faculty advisor, you'll craft a personalized curriculum that aligns with your passions and career aspirations. This flexible program emphasizes critical thinking, problem-solving, and communication, preparing you for a wide range of professions and graduate studies. Interdisciplinary studies allows students to create an academic plan that explores three academic disciplines from across the University. This self-designed curriculum is perfect for students with diverse interests and career goals. Working closely with a faculty advisor, students select three areas of focus and develop a unique course of study. The program emphasizes critical thinking, research, and communication skills, preparing graduates for a variety of careers and graduate school.

International Business helps students explore the global economic, political, and social issues that affect business. Students pursuing this minor will gain a better understanding of how business is conducted on a global scale. This minor is open to all Sacred Heart University students.

The Irish Studies minor provides students with the opportunity to examine the complexity of Irish culture through the study of literature, history, religion, and the arts. Drawing on the expertise of faculty across the College of Arts and Sciences, the minor combines courses offered in multiple departments to give students an interdisciplinary understanding of Ireland past and present. Students interested in the minor should contact the English Department Chair, Dr. Margaret Moss, for more information.

Sacred Heart University’s Italian minor will help you learn to speak, read, and write Italian and provide you with a deeper understanding of Italian history and culture. You can use your minor in conjunction with any major and apply it to a variety of careers in the humanities, international relations, business, education, and social sciences. You will gain a global perspective and develop analytical and critical thinking skills, preparing you for a variety of roles in the global marketplace. Whether you study abroad in Italy or take courses on campus, you will learn from expert faculty and immerse yourself in the Italian language and culture.

The Sacred Heart University Bachelor of Arts in Journalism program combines the strengths of a liberal arts education with hands-on experience in various media. Through courses in writing, reporting, editing, video production, graphic design, and web development, students learn the fundamentals of modern journalism and news production in written, audio, video and interactive formats. Students can specialize in news, sports, or digital journalism, or combine interests in a broader curriculum. Our curriculum trains you to ethically gather, analyze, and present information to a diverse public. Journalism students learn to use cutting-edge technology to report on news and create content for various platforms, including print, broadcast, and online publications. Graduates are prepared for careers in a dynamic and evolving media landscape.

The Legal Studies minor provides students from any major with a basic understanding of the American legal system. Students will develop foundational knowledge and skills in legal research, analysis, and writing that are applicable to a variety of careers in law, government, public service, and business. This minor will also provide a strong background for students considering law school or other graduate studies in law or public policy.

The Associate of Arts in Liberal Arts prepares students for careers in fields that require critical thinking, strong communication skills, and a broad understanding of the world. This program emphasizes humanistic inquiry, scientific reasoning, and analytical skills, which are transferable to a wide variety of professions. The curriculum provides students with a foundational understanding of the arts, humanities, and social sciences, as well as a solid grounding in mathematics and natural sciences. Graduates will be well-prepared to pursue further education at the bachelor’s level or to enter the workforce directly. Sacred Heart University also offers a Bachelor of Arts in Liberal Arts, which provides a seamless transition for students wishing to continue their studies.

With Sacred Heart University's Bachelor of Science in Marketing, you’ll learn what makes customers tick – how to reach them, how to understand their needs, and how to create campaigns that inspire action. Marketing is a fast-growing field and a crucial part of any business, whether it’s a non-profit organization or a Fortune 500 company. Our engaging, hands-on program focuses on the core principles of marketing and prepares you for success in today’s evolving job market. You'll gain a strong foundation in marketing fundamentals, including consumer behavior, market research, advertising, social media marketing, and digital marketing strategies. You will learn to analyze market trends, develop effective marketing plans, and utilize digital tools to reach target audiences. Through a blend of theoretical knowledge and practical experience, you’ll develop critical thinking, communication, and problem-solving skills that are essential for a successful career in marketing. Our dedicated faculty, with extensive industry experience, provide personalized mentorship and guidance, ensuring you receive the support you need to thrive. Beyond the classroom, you’ll have opportunities to participate in internships, student organizations, and real-world projects, giving you a competitive edge in the job market.
Accreditation status: AACSB International – the premier global accrediting body for business schools.

description: Marketing has become a vital component of every organization's strategy. By taking a marketing minor, you will learn the fundamental skills needed to understand how to build brands, attract and retain customers, deliver value, and foster loyalty. The Marketing Minor is available to all students except those majoring in Marketing. It is a perfect complement to many majors, including Business Economics, Finance, Graphic Design, Communication and Media Arts, Sport Management, Psychology, Health Science, and more. To earn a minor in marketing, students must take a total of 18 credits (six courses) in marketing, including MKT 205 (Introduction to Marketing) and five additional 3-credit marketing courses. Students will work with their academic advisor to ensure that their marketing minor courses fit into their overall academic plan and align with their interests.

Mathematics is the foundation for all scientific and technological advances. The Bachelor of Science in mathematics provides students with a strong foundation in core mathematics subjects such as calculus, linear algebra, discrete mathematics, and differential equations, along with advanced courses in topics such as abstract algebra, real analysis, probability and statistics. Students completing the BS in mathematics will possess critical thinking skills, problem-solving skills, and quantitative and analytical reasoning skills needed to thrive in a wide variety of careers or in graduate study.

A minor in mathematics provides a strong foundation in a field that supports many STEM disciplines. Mathematics plays an essential role in understanding and explaining the world around us and has applications in business, biology, computer science, and engineering.

The Sacred Heart University Media Arts program is an interdisciplinary Bachelor of Arts program that offers students foundational skills and knowledge in audio, video, animation, graphic design and emerging media. By combining art and technology, students learn to critically analyze and creatively produce media in a variety of forms and platforms. The Media Arts program provides students with opportunities for research and creative expression through diverse projects that prepare them for a future in media. The program also provides an excellent foundation for graduate study. Graduates are prepared for careers in fields such as film, television, game design, digital marketing, animation, web design, podcasting, social media content creation, and multimedia production.

Sacred Heart University’s Middle Eastern Studies minor enables students to study the Middle East and North Africa from multiple disciplinary perspectives. This interdisciplinary minor allows students to apply the tools of political science, history, geography, economics, sociology, and religious studies to the study of the Middle East and North Africa as a region. The minor explores the region’s politics, culture, history, religions, and contemporary issues. It also examines the relationships of these countries to the rest of the world and their changing role in the international system. The Middle Eastern Studies minor is a multidisciplinary program drawing on courses in Arabic, economics, history, political science, and religious studies. It provides students with an integrated understanding of this strategically and culturally vital region of the world.

The Military Science minor offers students the opportunity to complement their academic major with an interdisciplinary program that includes topics related to leadership, military history, ethics, and national security. The minor is offered in collaboration with the Sacred Heart University Army Reserve Officers’ Training Corps (ROTC) program. This program is designed to provide students with a foundational understanding of military leadership and operations, and to prepare them for potential careers in the U.S. Army. Students in the minor will learn to develop critical thinking skills, problem-solving abilities, and an understanding of organizational leadership within a military context. The minor includes courses in military history, strategic studies, and leadership development, providing a comprehensive overview of the military profession.

Molecular & Cellular Biology delves into the fundamental mechanisms of life at its most intricate levels, from DNA replication and protein synthesis to cellular communication and tissue development. Students in this program will learn to use cutting-edge technologies to answer fundamental biological questions about health and disease. This program provides students with the critical thinking, research, and communication skills necessary for careers in various fields, including medicine, research, biotechnology, pharmacology, and education. Our faculty are active researchers, publishing in peer-reviewed journals and presenting at national and international conferences, ensuring students are taught the most up-to-date concepts and techniques in the field. Students are strongly encouraged to participate in faculty-mentored research, either during the academic year or as part of our Summer Undergraduate Research Program (SURP). Students also have the opportunity to participate in internships in academic, medical, and industrial laboratories.

The Bachelor of Arts in Music at Sacred Heart University offers a comprehensive, interdisciplinary approach to the study of music as a human endeavor. Students delve into the historical, theoretical, cultural, and practical dimensions of music, fostering a deep understanding and appreciation for its diverse forms and functions. With a strong emphasis on critical thinking, creative expression, and collaborative learning, the program prepares students for a wide range of career paths in music, arts management, education, and related fields, or for further graduate study. Sacred Heart University's location in Fairfield County, Connecticut, provides unique opportunities for students to engage with a vibrant arts community, attend professional performances, and participate in internships with local music organizations. The program aims to cultivate well-rounded musicians and scholars who are not only technically proficient but also articulate, analytical, and socially conscious.

The Sacred Heart University Music Minor provides students with the opportunity to explore a variety of musical traditions and disciplines through performance, theory, history, and cultural studies. Students develop skills in critical listening, creative expression, and analytical thinking while engaging with diverse musical repertoires and styles. The minor is flexible, allowing students to tailor their studies to their interests, whether in classical, jazz, popular, world music, or other areas. It complements a wide range of majors, enhancing cultural literacy and fostering a lifelong appreciation for music.

Are you fascinated by the complexity of the brain and how it impacts behavior? Neuroscience is an interdisciplinary field that examines the nervous system, focusing on its structure, function, development, and pathology. Neuroscience majors at SHU gain a comprehensive understanding of the brain and nervous system, integrating knowledge from biology, chemistry, psychology, and computer science. You will explore topics such as neuroanatomy, neurophysiology, neuropharmacology, cognitive neuroscience, and behavioral neuroscience. This program is designed to provide a strong foundation for various careers in scientific research, healthcare, education, and biotechnology.

Sacred Heart University’s Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) prepares you for a successful career in today’s evolving health care environment. As one of the largest nursing programs in Connecticut, we prepare students to be leaders in the field. Our program offers many opportunities to collaborate and innovate in interdisciplinary teams. Our student nurses gain valuable hands-on experience through clinical placements, service-learning and international experiences, state-of-the-art simulation labs, research projects with faculty, and student leadership opportunities. With a low faculty-to-student ratio, we provide a personalized education in a supportive learning environment. We are focused on cultivating the critical thinking and clinical skills necessary to provide evidence-based, patient-centered care. Graduates are prepared for a variety of nursing roles and are eligible to sit for the National Council Licensure Examination (NCLEX-RN).
Accreditation status: The baccalaureate degree program in nursing at Sacred Heart University is accredited by the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education, 655 K Street NW, Suite 750, Washington, DC 20001, 202-887-6791. Sacred Heart University's School of Nursing is also accredited by the Connecticut State Board of Examiners for Nursing.

description: Occupational Therapy (OT) is a health and rehabilitation profession focused on helping people across the lifespan participate in the things they want and need to do through the therapeutic use of everyday activities (occupations). Common occupational therapy interventions include helping children with disabilities to participate fully in school and social situations, helping people recovering from injury to regain skills, and providing support for older adults experiencing physical and cognitive changes. Sacred Heart University's Occupational Therapy Program offers a combined Bachelor of Science in Health Science and Master of Science in Occupational Therapy (BS/MOT) program for high school students interested in a career in occupational therapy. This accelerated program takes five years to complete compared to the typical six years. Students are admitted to the professional phase of the program after successfully completing the first three years of undergraduate coursework with the required academic average and specific pre-requisite courses. The professional phase consists of two years of graduate coursework and fieldwork. Students completing the program are eligible to sit for the National Board for Certification in Occupational Therapy (NBCOT) examination to become a Registered Occupational Therapist (OTR).
Accreditation status: The Occupational Therapy Program at Sacred Heart University is accredited by the Accreditation Council for Occupational Therapy Education (ACOTE) of the American Occupational Therapy Association (AOTA), located at 6116 Executive Boulevard, Suite 200, North Bethesda, MD 20852-4929. ACOTE’s telephone number c/o AOTA is (301) 652-AOTA and its Web address is www.acoteonline.org.

description:
Welcome to the Sacred Heart University Philosophy Department, where we invite you to embark on a profound journey of critical thinking, ethical inquiry, and intellectual exploration. Our department is dedicated to fostering a vibrant academic community where students engage with fundamental questions about existence, knowledge, values, and the human condition.
Whether you choose to pursue a major or a minor in Philosophy, you will develop invaluable skills in logical reasoning, analytical thinking, and effective communication. Our curriculum is designed to challenge your assumptions, broaden your perspectives, and equip you with the intellectual tools necessary to navigate an increasingly complex world.
At Sacred Heart University, philosophy is not merely an academic discipline; it is a way of life—a commitment to thoughtful inquiry, ethical action, and the pursuit of wisdom. Join us as we explore the rich history of philosophical thought, engage with contemporary issues, and cultivate the intellectual virtues that will empower you to make a meaningful difference in the world.

The Sacred Heart University bachelor of arts in Philosophy, Politics & Economics (PPE) provides an interdisciplinary and integrative approach to understanding and addressing issues of social justice and economic welfare. Drawing on the disciplines of philosophy, political science, and economics, the PPE major emphasizes critical thinking, ethical reasoning, and evidence-based decision-making. Students develop a deep understanding of the foundations of political, economic, and social institutions and the complex interplay between them. The PPE major is highly customizable, allowing students to tailor their coursework to their specific interests and career goals. Students choose courses from each of the three disciplines, including options in moral philosophy, political theory, public policy, microeconomics, macroeconomics, and international economics. The program culminates in a capstone project that allows students to apply their interdisciplinary knowledge to a real-world problem or policy issue. Graduates of the PPE program are well-prepared for a wide range of careers in law, public service, business, and non-profit organizations, as well as for graduate study in related fields.

Sacred Heart University’s accelerated BS/DPT program offers highly motivated students a direct path to a rewarding career as a doctor of physical therapy. This integrated six-year program combines foundational liberal arts and science courses with a comprehensive physical therapy curriculum, preparing you for advanced clinical practice. Our state-of-the-art facilities, extensive clinical partnerships, and dedicated faculty provide an immersive learning experience focused on evidence-based practice and patient-centered care. Graduates are well-prepared to excel in diverse healthcare settings and contribute meaningfully to the physical therapy profession.
Accreditation status: The Doctor of Physical Therapy program at Sacred Heart University is accredited by the Commission on Accreditation in Physical Therapy Education (CAPTE), 3030 Potomac Ave., Suite 100, Alexandria, Virginia 22305-3085; telephone: 703-706-3245; email: accreditation@apta.org; website: http://www.capteonline.org. If needing to contact the program/institution directly, please call 203-365-7634 or email pt@sacredheart.edu.

description: From studying gravity, forces, and motion to energy, sound, light, electricity, and magnetism, physics is the scientific field that examines how the universe works. If you are interested in exploring a career as a scientist, engineer, or educator, Sacred Heart University’s Bachelor of Science (BS) in physics program provides the solid foundational knowledge and hands-on laboratory experience you need to succeed. Our challenging program combines rigorous classroom instruction with extensive practical experience in our state-of-the-art physics labs. You will learn to think critically, solve problems, analyze data, and communicate effectively—skills that are highly valued in any profession. Physics majors at SHU gain a comprehensive understanding of the physical world and develop valuable analytical skills that are applicable in a wide range of careers. The physics program culminates in a senior capstone research project where you will apply your knowledge to solve real-world problems. This project provides an opportunity to delve deeper into a specific area of physics that interests you and to showcase your research skills.

Physics is a foundational science, integral to understanding the fundamental nature of the universe. In this program, you will develop problem-solving skills, critical thinking, and a deep appreciation for the scientific method. At SHU, we emphasize hands-on learning, encouraging students to engage in research and apply theoretical knowledge to real-world scenarios. Our faculty are dedicated mentors, guiding students through challenging coursework and fostering a collaborative learning environment. Whether you aspire to contribute to scientific research, innovative technology, or advanced studies, a Physics degree from SHU equips you with the analytical and technical skills essential for success.

Concentration name: American politics, comparative politics, international relations, political theory, public law and public policy, global studies
description: The study of political science helps students develop a critical understanding of political systems, institutions, processes, and policies. It encourages students to think broadly about politics, power, and society, as well as the important questions of justice, equality, and freedom. The Political Science curriculum offers a comprehensive education in American politics, comparative politics, international relations, political theory, public law, and public policy, as well as global studies. The program is designed to develop students’ analytical, research, and communication skills, which are essential for success in a wide range of careers and graduate programs. Specializations within the Political Science major include American politics, comparative politics, international relations, political theory, public law and public policy, and global studies. The major emphasizes critical thinking, close reading, rigorous writing, and oral communication. The curriculum also promotes engagement in co-curricular activities and public service. A Political Science major teaches students how to be active and responsible citizens in a democratic society and a global community.

Sacred Heart University’s Bachelor of Arts in Psychology is designed to provide a broad understanding of the field and prepare students for a variety of careers or graduate study. The program emphasizes critical thinking, research methods, and ethical practice. Students explore topics such as human development, social psychology, cognitive processes, abnormal psychology, and neuroscience. The curriculum offers a balance of theoretical knowledge and practical experience, including opportunities for internships, research projects, and community engagement.

The minor in psychology is available to all Sacred Heart University students. It requires 18 credits in psychology, of which nine credits must be at the 200-level or above. Students must take PS 101: Introduction to Psychology. For their remaining five courses (15 credits), students may choose any psychology courses. The minor allows students to broaden their knowledge in the discipline of psychology to complement their chosen major.

The Bachelor of Science (BS) in Public Health is designed to prepare students to advance public health through a variety of careers in both clinical and community settings. Students will explore and develop an understanding of epidemiology, social and behavioral health, environmental health, and health policy and management. Graduates will develop skills in the core competencies of public health by focusing on population health across the lifespan, health education and promotion, and the prevention of disease and injury. The Public Health BS program at Sacred Heart University emphasizes hands-on learning, community engagement, and critical thinking to address complex public health challenges.

The RN to Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) program at Sacred Heart University is designed specifically for registered nurses who wish to advance their education and career. This program offers a flexible and convenient pathway for RNs to earn a bachelor’s degree in nursing, enhancing their professional knowledge, leadership skills, and career opportunities. Through a comprehensive curriculum, students will deepen their understanding of evidence-based practice, healthcare policy, community health, and nursing leadership. The program emphasizes critical thinking, ethical decision-making, and cultural competency, preparing graduates to provide high-quality, patient-centered care in diverse healthcare settings. Sacred Heart University’s RN to BSN program is ideal for working nurses, offering both online and hybrid course options to accommodate busy schedules. Graduates are prepared for advanced roles in clinical practice, education, administration, and public health, contributing to improved patient outcomes and the advancement of the nursing profession.
Accreditation status: The baccalaureate degree program in nursing at Sacred Heart University is accredited by the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE), 655 K Street, NW, Suite 750, Washington, DC 20001, 202-887-6791.
Program name: RN to Bachelor of Science in Nursing - BSN

description: The Sacred Heart University Bachelor of Arts (BA) in Social Work prepares you to become a generalist social worker. Graduates are trained to work with individuals, families, groups, organizations, and communities within diverse practice settings. We prepare our graduates to work with the most vulnerable populations who are facing a multitude of issues across the lifespan. Through our curriculum, you will develop the knowledge, values, and skills to provide ethical, anti-racist, and trauma-informed social work services. Our goal is to promote social and economic justice while working to alleviate poverty and oppression. The BA in Social Work prepares students for either employment at the baccalaureate level or graduate education for advanced practice.
Accreditation status: Accredited by the Council on Social Work Education (CSWE) Commission on Accreditation.

description: Sociology is the scientific study of human society, social behavior, and social structure. It examines how social forces and institutions influence individuals and groups, as well as how individuals and groups shape society. Sociologists explore various topics, including social inequality, race and ethnicity, gender, family, crime, education, religion, and globalization. Through rigorous research methods and theoretical frameworks, sociologists strive to understand the complexities of social life, analyze social problems, and contribute to positive social change. Our department offers a Bachelor of Science (BS) degree in sociology. Our BS in sociology offers you a comprehensive understanding of human behavior and societal structures. The program is specifically designed to provide you with the theoretical knowledge and research skills necessary to analyze complex social issues and contribute to positive social change. With a strong emphasis on research methods and statistical analysis, you will develop a deep understanding of social phenomena and their impact on individuals and communities. Sociology graduates are well-prepared for a variety of careers in social work, public administration, education, market research, urban planning, law enforcement, and more. The analytical, research, and communication skills acquired through a sociology degree are highly valued in diverse professional settings. Additionally, the BS in sociology provides an excellent foundation for graduate studies in sociology, social work, law, and other related fields.

The Spanish major focuses on an in-depth study of the Spanish language and its literature. This program prepares students for a career in education or graduate study, and it pairs well with other majors or minors. You will enhance your understanding of Hispanic culture through the study of authors and texts from Spain, Latin America and the United States. The Spanish major offers a well-rounded curriculum in Spanish language, literature, culture, linguistics, and civilization. Our students gain fluency and proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing, and they develop a comprehensive knowledge of the diverse cultures of the Spanish-speaking world.

Whether you plan to continue your studies or work in your chosen field, adding a minor in Spanish will enhance your career opportunities. Being fluent in Spanish and having an understanding of Hispanic cultures will open doors to new career paths both domestically and abroad. Our Spanish minor provides students with competency in the language and a broad understanding of the Spanish and Latin American cultures, as well as opportunities for cultural enrichment through a range of experiences from community engagement to study abroad. Students who major in Spanish may not minor in Spanish.

Speech-language pathology is a rewarding profession where you can make a meaningful difference in the lives of individuals with communication disorders. As a speech-language pathologist, you will diagnose and treat a wide range of speech, language, cognitive, voice, and swallowing disorders across the lifespan. You'll work with diverse populations in various settings, including schools, hospitals, rehabilitation centers, and private practices. Sacred Heart University's Bachelor of Science (B.S.) in Speech-Language Pathology program provides a comprehensive and rigorous curriculum designed to prepare students for graduate studies and a successful career in the field. Our program emphasizes evidence-based practices, clinical reasoning, and interprofessional collaboration. Students gain a strong foundation in communication sciences and disorders, develop critical thinking skills, and learn to apply their knowledge in real-world settings. With dedicated faculty, state-of-the-art facilities, and diverse clinical experiences, we are committed to fostering compassionate and competent speech-language pathologists who are prepared to meet the communication needs of individuals and communities.
Accreditation status: Sacred Heart University’s Speech-Language Pathology Program, Bachelor of Science (BS) is an accredited program recognized by the Council on Academic Accreditation in Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology (CAA) of the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association (ASHA). This accreditation signifies that our program meets rigorous academic and professional standards, ensuring that our graduates are well-prepared for entry-level practice and further graduate studies. The CAA's accreditation is a testament to the quality and excellence of our curriculum, faculty, and clinical education experiences.

description: The world of sports is complex and diverse, requiring professionals with a wide range of skills to manage various aspects such as marketing, finance, operations, and human resources. Sacred Heart University’s Bachelor of Science (B.S.) in Sport Management program prepares you for a rewarding career in this dynamic field. Our curriculum combines business principles with sport-specific knowledge, providing you with a solid foundation in both areas. You'll gain a deep understanding of the unique challenges and opportunities within the sport industry, from amateur to professional levels. Through a blend of classroom learning, experiential opportunities, and industry connections, you'll develop the practical skills and theoretical knowledge needed to succeed. Our faculty, composed of experienced professionals and scholars, are dedicated to providing a supportive and engaging learning environment. Whether you aspire to work in professional sports, collegiate athletics, event management, or sport marketing, our program equips you with the tools to achieve your goals. Join us and turn your passion for sports into a successful career.

The Sports Communication & Media major provides a comprehensive understanding of the communication and media aspects of the sports industry. Students learn about sports journalism, broadcasting, public relations, social media, and marketing within a sports context. The curriculum emphasizes hands-on experience through internships, campus media organizations, and real-world projects. Students will develop strong writing, speaking, and digital media production skills, essential for success in today’s evolving media landscape. Core courses cover topics such as sports reporting, media law and ethics, sports broadcasting production, public relations in sports, and digital sports content creation. The program also allows for elective courses in areas of interest, providing flexibility for students to tailor their education to specific career goals.

The Sports Management minor is an 18-credit program providing students with fundamental business, communication, and management skills necessary to succeed in the diverse sports industry. This minor is open to all Sacred Heart University students and can be paired with any major.

Strategic Communication, Public Relations & Advertising is one of the most exciting, dynamic, and rapidly evolving fields in the country. Our program offers you the opportunity to learn how to communicate effectively, think critically and creatively, and apply those skills to various professional contexts, from public relations and advertising to corporate communications and social media. You will gain a solid foundation in communication theory and research, while also developing practical skills in writing, speaking, presenting, and problem-solving. This includes opportunities to:
*   Develop a portfolio of work to showcase your skills and talents
*   Gain real-world experience through internships and practicums
*   Network with professionals in the field
*   Learn from award-winning faculty with diverse backgrounds and expertise
*   Travel to national communication conferences

The curriculum combines theory with hands-on practice, preparing you for a variety of careers in both the private and public sectors.
